Vertices live in dense slots and edges at positions
and an in-row, each with a parallel row of edge positions. Removal is swap-remove: removing an
edge moves the last edge into its position, and removing a vertex moves the last slot into its
place, so vertex order, edge order and edge positions may change after a removal. The copies
from one vertex to another form a parallel class in insertion order.
